segments.t: In the quiet back hallway behind the kitchen, Qing and Chen stand before a tall wooden bookcase packed with old travel guides. Mei hurries out of the café corner, wiping flour from her hands. Let's listen in first.
真的吗？我厨房的墙后面真的有一个秘密房间？
小美，帮我把这些绿色的大书放到椅子上。
先拿最上面一层，这样书架就轻了。
小晴，这些旅游书比我们俩还老！
这是最后一层了。老陈，准备好一起拉了吗？
一，二，三——左边往我这边拉！
快看木头后面！白漆，还有一个铜钥匙孔！
一扇真的门，就藏在走廊里！
我们试试香柏木盒子里的那把大钥匙。
老陈，能转吗？
往右用力转一下……开了！
先把把手往上提——跟大门一样！
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
真的吗？我厨房的墙后面真的有一个秘密房间？
'Is it true? Is there really a secret room behind my kitchen wall?'
小美，帮我把这些绿色的大书放到椅子上。
'Mei, help me put these big green books on the chair.'
先拿最上面一层，这样书架就轻了。
'Take the top shelf first, so the bookcase gets lighter.'
小晴，这些旅游书比我们俩还老！
'Qing, these travel books are older than both of us!'
这是最后一层了。老陈，准备好一起拉了吗？
'That's the last shelf. Chen, ready to pull together?'
一，二，三——左边往我这边拉！
'One, two, three—pull the left side toward me!'
快看木头后面！白漆，还有一个铜钥匙孔！
'Look behind the wood! White paint, and a brass keyhole!'
一扇真的门，就藏在走廊里！
'A real door, hidden right here in the hallway!'
我们试试香柏木盒子里的那把大钥匙。
'Let's try the big key from the cedar box.'
老陈，能转吗？
'Chen, does it turn?'
往右用力转一下……开了！
'One firm turn to the right... and it's open!'
先把把手往上提——跟大门一样！
'Lift the handle first—just like the front door!'
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.

The heavy bookcase is aside and the hidden lock turns on the first try. Lift, pull, turn, open: those action words will keep coming back. See you next time.
下次见！
